articles.title_en: Mental Accounts and Consumption Sensitivity across the Distribution of Liquid Assets
articles.title_cn: 心理账户与流动资产分布中的消费敏感性
articles.abstract_en: We study consumption spending responses to predictable income using household-level data from a US financial institution. Even for households with large liquid asset balances, we find no spending in anticipation of income receipt, substantial spending following receipt, and significant front-loading with respect to date of receipt. To rationalize these findings, we develop a tractable model of mental accounts where consumption choices are partitioned across current income and current assets. Our model reproduces the timing, magnitude, and cross-section of consumption responses observed in the data. Finally, we use the model to study the effectiveness of targeted and untargeted fiscal stimulus policies. (JEL D12, E21, E62, G21, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国金融机构的家庭层面数据研究消费支出对可预测收入的反应。即使对于拥有大量流动资产余额的家庭，我们也未发现收入到账前的预期性支出，收入到账后则有显著支出，并且相对于收入到账日期存在明显的前置消费。为合理化这些发现，我们构建了一个易于处理的心理账户模型，其中消费选择在当前收入和当前资产之间进行划分。我们的模型再现了数据中观察到的消费反应的时间、幅度和横截面特征。最后，我们利用该模型研究定向和非定向财政刺激政策的有效性。(JEL D12, E21, E62, G21, G51)

articles.title_en: ‘Less Is More’: Consumer Spending and the Size of Economic Stimulus Payments
articles.title_cn: “少即是多”：消费者支出与经济刺激支付规模
articles.abstract_en: We study how consumption responds to unexpected, transitory income gains of different sizes using hypothetical questions from the Italian Survey of Household Income and Wealth. Affluent households exhibit higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) out of large gains, while liquidity-poor families show higher MPCs out of small gains.The spending patterns of higher earners align with models featuring non-homothetic preferences, whereas borrowing constraints explain the heterogeneity among low-income households. Our findings imply that, for a given fiscal outlay, distributing smaller transfers to a broader group of low-income households stimulates aggregate consumption more effectively than concentrating larger transfers among fewer recipients. (JEL D12, E21, E62, G51, H23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用意大利家庭收入与财富调查中的假设性问题，研究了消费如何应对不同规模的意外、暂时性收入增加。富裕家庭在较大规模收入增加时表现出更高的边际消费倾向（MPCs），而流动性匮乏的家庭在较小规模收入增加时表现出更高的MPCs。高收入者的支出模式与非同质偏好模型一致，而借贷约束解释了低收入家庭之间的异质性。我们的研究结果表明，在给定的财政支出下，向更广泛的低收入家庭群体分配较小规模的转移支付，比将较大规模的转移支付集中在少数受助者身上更能有效刺激总消费。（JEL D12, E21, E62, G51, H23）

articles.title_en: From Deviations to Shortfalls: The Effects of the FOMC’s New Employment Objective
articles.title_cn: 从偏离到缺口：联邦公开市场委员会新就业目标的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effects of a monetary policy that stabilizes “shortfalls” rather than “deviations” of employment from its maximum level. A shortfalls-stabilization rule leads to expectations of more accommodative policy in expansions, raising average inflation and nominal rates. These effects are significantly amplified by incorporating history dependence in labor markets, a feature in labor-search frameworks. In a calibrated model of labor-search frictions and nominal rigidities, the adoption of a shortfalls rule raises average inflation and nominal policy rates by 90 basis points, reduces the likelihood of a binding zero lower bound, and implies a steeper and nonlinear Phillips curve. (JEL E24, E31, E43, E52, E58, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一种稳定就业“缺口”而非“偏离”其最大水平的货币政策的影响。缺口稳定规则会导致在经济扩张时期预期政策更加宽松，从而提高平均通胀和名义利率。这些效应在劳动力市场中纳入历史依赖性时会被显著放大，这是劳动搜寻框架的一个特征。在一个校准的劳动搜寻摩擦和名义刚性模型中，采用缺口规则会使平均通胀和名义政策利率提高90个基点，降低零利率下限约束的可能性，并意味着更陡峭且非线性的菲利普斯曲线。（JEL E24, E31, E43, E52, E58, J64）

articles.title_en: Uncertainty and the Economy: The Evolving Distributions of Aggregate Supply and Demand Shocks
articles.title_cn: 不确定性与经济：总供给与总需求冲击的演变分布
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the time-varying distribution of aggregate supply (AS) and aggregate demand (AD) shocks. We distinguish between traditional Gaussian uncertainty and “bad” uncertainty, associated with negative skewness. The Great Moderation is driven by a reduction in the volatility of AS shocks and the Gaussian component of AD shocks. The increased role of “bad” demand uncertainty implies that the conditional skewness of GDP growth and inflation has decreased over time. The correlation between AS/AD shocks and shocks to their conditional volatilities is generally strongly negative. The correlation between inflation and growth shocks has increased due to a decrease in AS volatility. (JEL C52, D81, E12, E23, E31, E32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了总供给（AS）和总需求（AD）冲击的时变分布。我们区分了传统的高斯不确定性与与负偏度相关的“坏”不确定性。大缓和是由AS冲击波动性的降低以及AD冲击的高斯成分驱动的。“坏”需求不确定性作用的增强意味着GDP增长和通胀的条件偏度随时间下降。AS/AD冲击与其条件波动性冲击之间的相关性通常强烈为负。通胀与增长冲击之间的相关性因AS波动性的降低而增强。（JEL C52, D81, E12, E23, E31, E32）

articles.title_en: Trade, Value Added, and Productivity Linkages: A Quantitative Analysis
articles.title_cn: 贸易、增加值与生产率关联：一项定量分析
articles.abstract_en: Traditional international real business cycle (IRBC) models produce a weak relationship between trade and cross-country real GDP (RGDP) correlations (corrRGDP), contradicting empirical findings. We reassess this quantitative puzzle in a many-country model featuring (i) global value chains, (ii) monopolistic competition, (iii) fluctuations in the number of varieties, and (iv) RGDP measurement using double deflation. In this framework, fluctuations in imported inputs cause profit and efficiency variations, reflected in measured GDP and productivity fluctuations. Using actual variations in trade linkages, the model replicates 70 percent of observed bilateral trade linkages to corrRGDP slope and 60 percent of productivity correlation slope. (JEL E13, E23, E32, F12, F23, F44, L14)
articles.abstract_cn: 传统的国际实际经济周期（IRBC）模型在贸易与跨国实际GDP（RGDP）相关性（corrRGDP）之间产生弱关联，这与实证发现相矛盾。我们在一个多国模型中重新评估这一量化难题，该模型包含（i）全球价值链，（ii）垄断竞争，（iii）品种数量的波动，以及（iv）使用双重缩减法的RGDP测量。在此框架下，进口投入品的波动引起利润和效率的变化，反映在测量的GDP和生产率波动中。利用实际贸易关联的变化，该模型复制了观察到的双边贸易关联与corrRGDP斜率之间的70%，以及生产率相关斜率的60%。（JEL E13, E23, E32, F12, F23, F44, L14）

articles.title_en: Accounting for Wealth Concentration in the United States
articles.abstract_en: We assess the empirical relevance of different macroeconomic modeling approaches to wealth concentration, using the joint distribution of earnings, capital income, and net worth in combination with an OLG model of household heterogeneity. We find large earnings disparities to be the primary source of US wealth concentration. This reflects the fact that labor income, from salaries but also from entrepreneurship, is a major income source for top income and wealth groups in the data. Bequests and differences in rates of return on capital together explain about half the holdings of the wealthiest households. (JEL D31, E25, G51, J23, J31, L26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用收入、资本收入和净值的联合分布，结合家庭异质性OLG模型，评估了不同宏观经济建模方法对财富集中的实证相关性。我们发现，巨大的收入差距是美国财富集中的主要来源。这反映了劳动收入，包括工资收入和创业收入，在数据中是高收入和高财富群体的主要收入来源。遗产和资本回报率差异共同解释了最富有家庭约一半的财富持有。(JEL D31, E25, G51, J23, J31, L26)

articles.abstract_en: We show that differential IT investment across cities has been a key driver of job and wage polarization since the 1990s. Using a novel dataset, we establish two stylized facts: IT investment is highest in firms in large and expensive cities, and the decline in routine cognitive occupations is most prevalent in large and expensive cities. We propose and estimate a model and find that the fall in IT prices helps explain the wage gap between routine and nonroutine cognitive jobs, as well as the shift in employment away from routine cognitive toward nonroutine cognitive jobs. (JEL D22, G31, J24, J31, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，自1990年代以来，城市间差异化的信息技术投资一直是就业和工资极化的关键驱动因素。利用一项新颖的数据集，我们确立了两个典型事实：信息技术投资在大型且昂贵城市的企业中最高，而常规认知职业的下降在大型且昂贵的城市中最为普遍。我们提出并估计了一个模型，发现信息技术价格的下降有助于解释常规与非常规认知工作之间的工资差距，以及就业从常规认知工作向非常规认知工作的转移。(JEL D22, G31, J24, J31, R23)

articles.title_en: Anatomy of the Greek Depression with Firm-Level Data: The Importance of Demand Shocks
articles.title_cn: 基于企业层面数据的希腊萧条解剖：需求冲击的重要性
articles.abstract_en: During the Greek Depression, which saw a 22 percent decline in output, young firms and small firms experienced significantly steeper declines in sales growth compared to their mature and larger counterparts. This disparity was largely driven by adverse demand shocks and was further intensified by financing constraints (FCs), with a significant interaction between these two factors amplifying the impact. Firm-level heterogeneity played a critical role in shaping macroeconomic outcomes, with the disproportionate impact on young firms and small firms accounting for approximately one-quarter of the total output decline during the crisis. (JEL D22, E23, E32, E44, G32, L25)
articles.abstract_cn: 在希腊萧条期间，产出下降了22%，年轻企业和小型企业的销售增长率下降幅度显著大于成熟企业和大型企业。这种差异主要由不利的需求冲击驱动，并因融资约束（FCs）而进一步加剧，这两个因素之间的显著交互作用放大了影响。企业层面的异质性在塑造宏观经济结果中发挥了关键作用，对年轻企业和小型企业的过度影响约占危机期间总产出下降的四分之一。（JEL D22, E23, E32, E44, G32, L25）

articles.title_en: The Effects of Biased Labor Market Expectations on Consumption, Wealth Inequality, and Welfare
articles.title_cn: 有偏劳动市场预期对消费、财富不平等和福利的影响
articles.abstract_en: We analyze US survey data and document a substantial optimistic bias of households in their expectations about future labor market transitions. We find that low-skilled individuals tend to be strongly overoptimistic, whereas high-skilled individuals have rather precise beliefs. Using a heterogeneous agents life cycle model, we show that the optimistic bias has a quantitatively sizable negative effect on income, consumption, and wealth, implying a substantial loss in individual welfare compared to the full information case. Moreover, the skill gradient in the bias leads to pronounced differences in asset accumulation across individuals, making it a quantitatively important driver of wealth inequality. (JEL D15, D31, D83, D84, E21, G51, J24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国调查数据，并记录了家庭对未来劳动市场转变预期的显著乐观偏差。我们发现，低技能个体往往表现出强烈的过度乐观，而高技能个体的信念则相对精确。利用异质性代理人生命周期模型，我们表明，乐观偏差对收入、消费和财富具有数量上显著为负的影响，与完全信息情形相比，导致个体福利的显著损失。此外，偏差中的技能梯度导致个体间资产积累的显著差异，使其成为财富不平等的一个数量上重要的驱动因素。(JEL D15, D31, D83, D84, E21, G51, J24)

articles.title_en: Parallel Digital Currencies and Sticky Prices
articles.title_cn: 平行数字货币与价格粘性
articles.abstract_en: The rise of digital currencies may result in domestic parallel currencies. Their exchange rate shocks present new challenges for monetary policy. We analyze these issues in a New Keynesian framework. Firms set prices in one of the currencies. A one-time appreciation of a parallel currency results in persistent redistributions toward the Dollar sector output and inflation. We calculate optimal monetary policy. When price stickiness is homogeneous, it is optimal to leave nominal interest rates unchanged. We compare optimal policy to three Taylor rules. Higher dollar price rigidity may lead to an increase rather than a decrease in the Dollar sector. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E42, E52, F33)
articles.abstract_cn: 数字货币的兴起可能导致国内平行货币的出现。其汇率冲击给货币政策带来了新的挑战。我们在新凯恩斯框架下分析这些问题。企业以一种货币设定价格。平行货币的一次性升值会导致向美元部门产出和通胀的持续性再分配。我们计算最优货币政策。当价格粘性同质时，保持名义利率不变是最优的。我们将最优政策与三种泰勒规则进行比较。较高的美元价格刚性可能导致美元部门产出增加而非减少。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E42, E52, F33）

articles.title_en: Bank Risk-Taking, Credit Allocation, and Monetary Policy Transmission: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 银行风险承担、信贷配置与货币政策传导：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using confidential loan-level data, we examine how Basel III influenced the responses of bank risk-taking to monetary policy shocks in China. We use a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, exploiting disparities in lending behavior between high- and low-risk bank branches before and after the new regulations. Our findings reveal a novel risk-weighting channel through which monetary policy easing significantly reduced bank risk-taking. However, this risk reduction was achieved by shifting lending towards ostensibly low-risk state-owned enterprises (SOEs) with government guarantees, despite their lower average productivity. Our findings suggest a trade-off facing China’s monetary policy between curbing bank risks and addressing credit misallocation. (JEL E52, G21, G28, L32, O16, P24, P34)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用保密贷款层面的数据，我们考察了巴塞尔协议III如何影响中国银行风险承担对货币政策冲击的反应。我们采用双重差分（DID）方法，利用新规实施前后高风险与低风险银行分支机构在贷款行为上的差异。我们的发现揭示了一个新颖的风险权重渠道，通过该渠道，货币政策宽松显著降低了银行风险承担。然而，这种风险降低是通过将贷款转向表面上低风险、拥有政府担保的国有企业（SOEs）实现的，尽管这些企业的平均生产率较低。我们的发现表明，中国货币政策在抑制银行风险与解决信贷错配之间面临权衡。（JEL E52, G21, G28, L32, O16, P24, P34）
